checks.name: Authorized source
checks.expected: blueprint and candidate both confirm an authorized institutional source

checks.name: Teaser duration
checks.expected: 60-90 seconds and within 1 second of blueprint target (75)

checks.name: Claim-to-source traceability
checks.expected: every selected claim has transcript evidence and a valid source time range

checks.name: Source-supported claims
checks.expected: zero claims unsupported by the original recording

checks.name: Single-concept teaser structure
checks.expected: hook, context, one concept, takeaway, call to action in order

checks.name: Caption coverage
checks.expected: 100% spoken-content coverage when captions are required

checks.name: Caption word accuracy
checks.expected: at least 95% against the verified transcript

checks.name: Audio-video synchronization
checks.expected: audio and video are acceptably synchronized

checks.name: Clip boundary integrity
checks.expected: cuts preserve complete phrases and do not mislead

checks.name: Call to action and source link
checks.expected: required call to action links to the full source recording

checks.name: Learner evidence governance
checks.expected: ethics-approved learner evidence with a recorded sample size

checks.name: Learner comprehension
checks.expected: at least 80% correct in the approved pilot

failures.message: Source-supported claims: expected zero claims unsupported by the original recording; observed 1.
Context preservation: expected required explanatory context is present; observed False.
